name: hope
description: Challenge work with evidence, understand pull requests, improve writing, and save shared preferences. Requires Node.js 20 or newer.

interface.shortDescription: Practical ways for people and AI to work better together
interface.longDescription: Toxic Review challenges work with evidence and clear priorities. Diff explains code changes so you can decide. Write improves language without changing its meaning. Settings saves Hope preferences.
defaultPrompt: Use $hope:diff to explain the current pull request.
Use $hope:write wherever clearer language would improve this task.
